summary: Iteration 4 - Frontend only. Tested photo before/after comparator and progression charts (weight + measurements). Seeded 3 measurements via localStorage (@ironflow/measurements) and verified: (1) 4 metric chips render with correct testIDs and orange/dark active state; (2) LineChart displays selected metric with delta chip in header; (3) chart hint shown when <2 measurements; (4) 'Comparer avant/après' card (open-compare) shown when >=2 photos, hidden otherwise; (5) /compare modal renders side-by-side photos, swap-compare button, delta card with 4 rows (delta-weight/waist/chest/thigh) and correct green/red improvement coloring; (6) picker sheet works: pick-before opens grid of pick-before-<id> thumbnails; (7) swap-compare reverses AVANT/APRÈS; (8) close-compare chevron returns to progress; (9) empty state 'Ajoute au moins 2 mesures avec photo pour comparer' displayed with <2 photos. All flows functional. Minor: deprecated warnings surfaced in console (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' - originates from a legacy Touchable component in the tree (likely inside a dependency). Reference: runtime console during progress/compare screen mount.

Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Should move resizeMode from StyleSheet to prop on <Image>. Reference: components using <Image style={{ resizeMode: ... }}>.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - use style prop instead. Reference: emitted globally on progress/compare mount.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining <Image style={{ resizeMode }}/> to <Image resizeMode={...} /> to silence deprecation warning.
Optional: audit for legacy Touchable* usage and switch to Pressable.
Optional: replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents where applicable.
critical_code_review_comments: progress.tsx chart delta text uses raw signed value (e.g. '-7.0 kg') even though a trending-up/down icon is shown; UX would be cleaner using Math.abs(delta) since the arrow already conveys direction, but current behavior matches spec ('Δ value + unit').
compare.tsx computes daysBetween from Math.abs so swap doesn't flip sign - good. DeltaRow correctly handles lowerBetter/higherBetter improvement coloring.
seed_data_creation: Seeded @ironflow/measurements in localStorage with 3 measurements (ids m1/m2/m3, dates 2025-01-05 / 2025-06-10 / 2026-01-05) each with weight_kg, waist_cm, thigh_cm, chest_cm, and a tiny base64 JPEG. Also tested empty (no photos) and single-measurement variants.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use localStorage.setItem('@ironflow/measurements', JSON.stringify([...])) to seed measurements. All measurement schema fields required (id, date ISO, weight_kg, waist_cm, thigh_cm, chest_cm, photoBase64, notes). Tabs use text 'Progrès' (French) - click via get_by_text. Compare modal is at /compare (Stack presentation:modal). All required testIDs present: metric-{weight_kg|waist_cm|chest_cm|thigh_cm}, open-compare, close-compare, swap-compare, pick-before, pick-after, pick-{before|after}-{id}, delta-{weight|waist|chest|thigh}.
